page.overview:
What is Accounting of Hours?

The Accounting of Hours was the primary religious text of the Amonkheti during Nicol Bolas's reign as the plane's God-Pharaoh. It is made up of a series of prophecies featured in the flavor text of the Amonkhet block.

The text prophesied the coming of the God-Pharaoh. According to the first prophecy, the Gate to the Afterlife would open when the Second Sun sat entirely between the horns on the horizon, revealing the promise of the God-Pharaoh. After the Hour of Devastation and the Phyrexian Invasion, the survivors on Amonkhet have begun to craft a new text: The Record of Days.

Notably absent in the texts is the Hour of Devastation.

When the Hours began, the events came to pass as foretold, but steeped heavily in irony, rather than what was expected by the citizens of Amonkhet.
